pattern: PR review request opens Ctrl's review session
experience: Asked to review a PR, the agent must group its chat and open the review session with the PR's url and head commit, instead of reviewing in chat or looking for a review-pr skill.
rule: get its url and headSha with gh pr view ... If t3_group_read shows your chat in no group, call t3_group_create with no arguments. Then call review_session_open and follow the brief it returns.

pattern: existing GitHub review is triaged, not rerun
experience: With a Copilot review already on GitHub, the agent must triage it into the review list, not start another review just to fill the panel or decide points itself.
rule: When a review is already posted on GitHub, triage it; never rerun it just to fill the list. Decisions are the user's.
